modern_c1_yi.program:
def find_front_guy(image):
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    ski_lift_patches = image_patch.find("ski lift")
    if not ski_lift_patches:
        return "No ski lifts found in the image."
    
    ski_lift_patch = ski_lift_patches[0]
    guy_patches = ski_lift_patch.find("guy")
    if not guy_patches:
        return "No guys found on the ski lift."
    
    # Sort the guy patches by their leftmost coordinate
    guy_patches.sort(key=lambda patch: patch.left)
    
    # The front guy is the one with the smallest leftmost coordinate
    front_guy = guy_patches[0]
    return front_guy

modern_c2_q7.program:
def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    people_patches = image_patch.find("person")
    ski_lift_patches = image_patch.find("ski lift")

    if not people_patches or not ski_lift_patches:
        return image_patch

    people_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in people_patches]
    ski_lift_centers = [(s.left + s.right) / 2 for s in ski_lift_patches]

    closest_person = min(people_patches, key=lambda p: abs((p.left + p.right) / 2 - ski_lift_centers[0]))
    return closest_person
